title: A Semantic Autonomy Framework for VLM-Integrated Indoor Mobile Robots: Hybrid Deterministic Reasoning and Cross-Robot Adaptive Memory
abstract: arXiv:2605.02525v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Semantic indoor navigation requires robots to connect human instructions with spatial destinations, execute missions and retain useful operational experience. This paper presents the Semantic Autonomy Stack (SAS), a six-layer integration framework, and develops its semantic-reasoning, mission-interface and operational-memory layers over a previously validated ROS 2/Nav2 foundation. A deterministic-first cascade combines the route graph, semantic objects, robot state and stored instruction-destination associations, escalating unresolved or guarded cases to a pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM). Recurrent model-mediated associations can pass a frequency-and-consistency gate and be compiled for deterministic M3 reuse; this gate measures sampled-output stability rather than semantic truth. translated_title: 面向VLM集成的室内移动机器人语义自主框架：混合确定性推理与跨机器人自适应记忆
translated_abstract: 语义室内导航要求机器人将人类指令与空间目的地关联起来、执行任务并保留有用的运行经验。本文提出了语义自主栈，这是一个六层集成框架，并在先前已验证的ROS 2/Nav2基础之上开发了其语义推理层、任务接口层和运行记忆层。一种“确定性优先”的级联机制将路线图、语义对象、机器人状态以及存储的指令-目的地关联相结合，并将未解决或受保护的情况升级交由预训练的视觉-语言模型处理。反复出现的由模型介导的关联可以通过频率-一致性门控，并被编译为确定性的M3记忆以供复用；该门控衡量的是采样输出的稳定性而非语义真实性。冻结版本的v4.8-review实现在一个室内环境中针对两种物理机器人配置进行了评估，具备机载导航能力……
tldr: 本文提出语义自主栈框架，通过“确定性优先”级联推理结合预训练视觉-语言模型，并将通过频率-一致性门控的模型关联编译为可复用的确定性记忆，使室内移动机器人能够将人类指令映射到目的地、执行任务并积累可跨机器人共享的运行经验。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Semantic Autonomy Stack (SAS), which couples deterministic-first cascade reasoning with a pretrained Vision-Language Model and compiles model-mediated associations passing a frequency-and-consistency gate into reusable deterministic memory, enabling indoor mobile robots to map human instructions to destinations, execute missions, and accumulate cross-robot operational experience.
